_comment: CFOperator MCP recipe — drop this in as .mcp.json (Claude Code) or merge the
'cfoperator' entry into an existing MCP host config. See docs/cockpit.md for the
alert -> investigation -> briefed-session workflow, and docs/mcp-server.md for the
Two entries, pick one and delete the other:
cfoperator       — stdio; the host launches `python -m mcp_server` locally.
Needs this repo checked out and its requirements installed,
plus a reachable agent (kubectl -n apps port-forward
cfoperator-http  — Streamable HTTP against an already-deployed MCP server.
Nothing to install. The bearer is resolved against the
console's auth_api_tokens table, so the *token's* own scopes
apply and CFOP_MCP_SCOPES is not consulted.
Scopes are a ladder: remediate > investigate > read. 'read' is enough to work an
incident (list/get investigations, list/get remediations, search knowledge);
'investigate' adds triage_alert / start_investigation / ask_sre. Never put
'remediate' in a shared host config — approve/reject belong to a deliberate
human action, not to an agent's tool loop.
